notes.title: Major Update
notes.notes: We just release a major update, fix some bugs and change the default language to English, please enjoy it.

notes.title: Wand Wars VR Now Available!
notes.notes:
Wand Wars VR Early Access now available!

Greetings everyone! After 18 months hard work, our new VR game is finally ready for you to play!

Hope you can enjoy the game, your feedbacks are valuable for us to improve it from Early Access to full version!
